name: Shepherd Netta

intro.text: Chalk downland sheep. They keep the turf short, and the flowers come. I'm doing my bit for the butterflies. Don't tell the ewes.

win: Righto. The ewes will be so cross with me.
after: The chalkhill blue only lives where the horseshoe vetch grows, and that only grows on grazed turf. It all depends on sheep.
